verdict.rationale: The pricing page says Resend will 'warmup, monitor, and autoscale it based on your utilization,' which in context reads as an automated warmup and scaling promise for a dedicated IP add-on. That covers the story's automated ramp-up path. The support rests on a single pricing-page line, and the excerpt does not even name the dedicated IP explicitly. Missing for 10: first-party docs on dedicated IP provisioning and eligibility or volume thresholds, a description of how warmup works or a published schedule, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
